name: Smart Compaction
description: Anti-thrash compaction guard: skips compaction if one already ran recently (within cooldown window), preventing back-to-back redundant compressions.

cooldownMs.description: Min milliseconds between compactions per session (default: 120000 = 2 min)

minMessagesSinceLastCompaction.description: Skip if fewer than N new messages since last compaction (default: 10)
